method: Record survey prevalence, daily frequency and country ad planner outputs with explicit distinct denominators; verify no attempt to convert a percentage to unique global people or to add account/ad estimates.
population: Surveyed internet users 16+ in GWI covered markets, Pew survey U.S. adults 18+, and independently planned advertising audiences in 3 countries

observations.scope: GWI covered markets including China and Russia
observations.notes: Cannot scale to the entire global population or count unique platform accounts.

observations.scope: GWI covered markets excluding China and Russia
observations.denominator: surveyed internet users 16+ in reduced geography
observations.notes: Different geography and denominator from the 55.3% figure.
Daily includes once or several times per day; not a measured count of server-active accounts or global persons.
A subset of at-least-daily use; never add to 48%.
Planner estimate, not daily use, monthly use or deduplicated person count.
Cannot compare to U.S. adult daily use percentage as population count.
Neither a MAU nor adult-only population census.

denominator_crosswalk_rules: Monthly platform persons require a defined monthly window, geography, signed-out handling, deduplication, and coverage across all eligible audiences; a survey percentage is not a census.
Global daily active users require a comparable calendar day or clearly defined rolling daily window of deduplicated platform people; annual daily-frequency survey response is not that count.
Ad-planner reach may change with campaign settings, eligible ages, geography and inventory; it is not a DAU, MAU or count of paying or creating people.
An online survey denominator of internet users 16+ excludes offline residents, younger people and some markets; ever-use is not past-month use.
Pew's 48% at least daily and 33% several times daily concern the same 2025 surveyed adult base; the latter is contained in the former.
Survey country and ad-planner figures have different data sources, periods, geographic coverage and measurement units: do not sum them into world MAU.
Co-viewing, logged-out use, multiple Google accounts, channel/account duplication and anonymized user models require explicit reconciliation.
